summary:
[  edit  ]
The Carve  SOP  works with any face or surface type, be that polygon, Bzier, or NURBS. It can be used to slice a primitive, cut it into multiple sections, or extract points or cross-sections from it.
Like the Project  SOP , it also creates profile curves, but they are extracted as iso-parametric (2D) profiles directly from a surface, whereas the Project  SOP  extracts a 3D curve projected onto a surface.
Note: When using a Carve  SOP  on a trimmed surface, you can't fillet or join the trim curves.

parameters.label: Group
parameters.name: group
parameters.description: If there are input groups, specifying a group name in this field will cause this  SOP  to act only upon the  Group  specified. Accepts patterns, as described in the Scripting Guide under  Pattern Matching .

parameters.label: First U
parameters.name: firstu
parameters.description: Enables the parameter to set the first position in U.

parameters.label: First U
parameters.name: domainu1
parameters.description: This specifies a starting location to begin the cut/extract. Select this and a parametric U location between 0 and 1.

parameters.label: Second U
parameters.name: secondu
parameters.description: Enables the parameter to set the second position in U.

parameters.label: Second U
parameters.name: domainu2
parameters.description: This specifies an ending location to complete the cut / extract. Select this and a parametric U location between 0 and 1.

parameters.label: First V
parameters.name: firstv
parameters.description: Enables the parameter to set the first position in V.

parameters.label: First V
parameters.name: domainv1
parameters.description: This specifies a starting location to begin the cut/extract. Select this and a parametric V location between 0 and 1. Applies only to surfaces.

parameters.label: Second V
parameters.name: secondv
parameters.description: Enables the parameter to set the second position in V.

parameters.label: Second V
parameters.name: domainv2
parameters.description: This specifies an ending location to complete the cut / extract. Select this and a parametric V location between 0 and 1. Applies only to surfaces.

parameters.label: Carve Method
parameters.name: method
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select between Cut and Extract methods.

parameters.label: Cut
parameters.name: cut
parameters.description: Cut will slice (or 'cut-out') the original geometry within the area specified on the Carve Page.

parameters.label: Extract
parameters.name: extract
parameters.description: Extract will create 3D curves, points, or 2D profiles within the area specified on the Carve page. The Extract Type parameter is used to determine what is extracted.

parameters.label: Keep Inside
parameters.name: keepin
parameters.description: Keep the primitives specified between the first and second locations.

parameters.label: Keep Outside
parameters.name: keepout
parameters.description: Keep the primitives lying outside the first and second locations.

parameters.label: Extract Type
parameters.name: extractop
parameters.description: ⊞  - If enabled, it will extract a cross-section along each location specified above.

parameters.label: Extract 3D Isoparametric Curve(s)
parameters.name: xisoparm
parameters.description: The extraction operation creates a 3-D, free-floating curve that matches the surface perfectly at the given U or V location.

parameters.label: Extract  Point (s)
parameters.name: xpoint
parameters.description: Available for Mesh and surfaces only. If selected, it will create a point at every U, V location specified, rather than removing a U cross section and a V cross section.

parameters.label: Extract 2D Isoparametric Profile(s)
parameters.name: xprofile
parameters.description: Creates a 2D curve at the specified U/V location that matches the surface perfectly.

parameters.label: Keep Original
parameters.name: keeporiginal
parameters.description: If selected, it will not remove the original primitive.

parameters.label: Location
parameters.name: location
parameters.description: ⊞  - Determines how the Cut/Extract is defined at the boundaries. Additionally, extra subdivisions can be added in two ways using the parameters below.

parameters.label: Divisions
parameters.name: div
parameters.description: The Cut/Extract occurs precisely at the locations defined on the Carve page. Additional divisions can be specified using the U/V Divisions parameters below and they are evenly distributed across the Cut/Extracted geoemtry.

parameters.label: Breakpoints
parameters.name: break
parameters.description: Performs cutting or extractions at breakpoints for curves and surfaces, at vertices for polygons, and along isoparms for meshes.

parameters.label: U Divisions
parameters.name: divsu
parameters.description: This specifies the number of cuts / extracts to be performed between first U and the second U.

parameters.label: V Divisions
parameters.name: divsv
parameters.description: Specifies the number of cuts/extracts to be performed between first V and second V.

parameters.label: Cut at All Internal U Breakpoints
parameters.name: allubreakpoints
parameters.description: When using Location = Breakpoints, the resulting primitive is divided at all U breakpoints into separate primitives.

parameters.label: Cut at All Internal V Breakpoints
parameters.name: allvbreakpoints
parameters.description: When using Location = Breakpoints, the resulting primitive is divided at all V breakpoints into separate primitives.

parameters.label: num_points
parameters.description: Number of points in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_prims
parameters.description: Number of primitives in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_particles
parameters.description: Number of particles in this  SOP .

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.

parameters.label: The Graphics Processing Unit. This is the high
parameters.description: speed, many-core processor of the graphics card/chip that takes geometry, images and data from the CPU and creates images and processed data.
